project: Wuxia Life P26 Personality Habit Trajectory Optimization
description: Connect long-term habit state to high-value content, midlife consequence, and replayability validation through execution-sized migrations.

userStories.title: Write P26 scope and migration rules
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit migration rules for P26 so that later stories stay focused on habit trajectory work.
acceptanceCriteria: Define allowed P26 habit axes: trainingHabit, studyHabit, businessHabit
Define in-scope layers: P21, P22, P17, P20/P25 validation
Define that legacy habit flags remain as compatibility projection in P26
Save the rules in the PRD or a linked design note

userStories.title: Audit current habit-gated content hits
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an inventory of habit-sensitive content so that migration order is based on impact.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current training_habit, study_habit, and business_habit readers
Classify each hit as content trigger, validation fixture, replayability surface, or compatibility-only
Record 3-6 highest-value direct migration targets
Save the audit under docs/test-reports or docs/designs

userStories.title: Add isolated habit regression test file
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an isolated habit regression test file so that P26 can be verified without relying on the noisy full suite.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a standalone test file for habit trajectory runtime checks
Cover ConditionEvaluator access to player.lifeStates and lifeStates shorthand
Cover daily long-term habit accumulation and compatibility flag projection
Test file runs independently and exits cleanly

userStories.title: Register isolated habit test in runRealTestGate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the new habit regression test registered in the standard gate list so future gates include it automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Add the new habit regression test entry to tests/runRealTestGate.ts
Use a clear test name identifying habit trajectory coverage
Do not modify unrelated gate entries

userStories.title: Migrate one P21 scholar reinforcement sample to studyHabit
userStories.description: As a player, I want one scholar reinforcement sample to read long-term study habit directly so scholarly identity can emerge from behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Update one P21 scholar reinforcement sample to read lifeStates.studyHabit >= threshold
Preserve any intended route or stage guard that still defines audience
Independent regression test proves trigger works without legacy study_habit flag

userStories.title: Migrate one P22 business fork sample to businessHabit
userStories.description: As a player, I want one merchant divergence sample to read long-term business habit directly so wealth-route identity can emerge from repeated livelihood behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Update one P22 business fork sample to read lifeStates.businessHabit >= threshold
Preserve any intentional origin fallback for merchant-house access
Independent regression test proves trigger works without legacy business_habit flag

userStories.title: Add one P21 training reinforcement sample driven by trainingHabit
userStories.description: As a player, I want one training reinforcement sample to read long-term training habit so martial identity is reinforced by repeated behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or migrate one P21 training-oriented sample to read lifeStates.trainingHabit >= threshold
Sample remains age-appropriate and route-consistent
Targeted test or fixture proves the new habit-sensitive access path
userStories.notes: Do not batch multiple P21 samples.

userStories.title: Add one P22 non-business fork sample driven by habit
userStories.description: As a player, I want one additional early fork outside the merchant path to prove habit-driven routing is reusable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or migrate one non-business P22 early fork sample
Sample reads either lifeStates.studyHabit or lifeStates.trainingHabit
Chosen identity direction differs from the merchant sample
Targeted test or fixture proves the habit-sensitive path

userStories.title: Add one adult callback sample for studyHabit
userStories.description: As a player, I want one age 20-35 callback event that acknowledges long-term study habit so early behavior has medium-term narrative echo.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one age 20-35 callback sample keyed by lifeStates.studyHabit
Text makes the long-term shaping legible to the player
Callback does not rely solely on legacy study_habit flag
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add one adult callback sample for a second habit axis
userStories.description: As a player, I want one more adult callback sample from a different habit axis so P26 proves multi-axis echo.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one age 20-35 callback sample keyed by trainingHabit or businessHabit
Chosen axis differs from P26-009
Callback introduces a believable opportunity, burden, or reinforcement outcome
Relevant tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on one prior callback pattern.

userStories.title: Add one P17 habit-borne consequence sample
userStories.description: As a player, I want at least one mid/late-life consequence event to acknowledge what kind of person I became so habits affect later responsibilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one P17 consequence sample keyed by a long-term habit axis
The consequence changes obligation, opportunity, pressure, or burden rather than only flavor text
Sample is distinct from route-only consequence logic
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add one P20 habit trajectory replayability slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a replayability slice comparing high-vs-low habit runs so divergence can be measured.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one P20 slice comparing representative runs with different habit accumulation
Slice reports whether event trajectory materially differs across habit profiles
Output is machine-readable and included in P20 reporting flow
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add one P25 habit trajectory acceptance slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a lifetime-acceptance slice proving early habit formation survives into later callback or consequence echo.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one P25 slice covering early habit formation and later echo
Slice records pass or fail with concrete event or flag pointers
Results surface inside existing P25 validation output
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Write P26 closure note and next migration queue
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure note for P26 so future sessions know what was proven and what should migrate next.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize migrated samples, new validation slices, and verification commands
List remaining high-value habit-flag content still not migrated to direct lifeStates reads
Record recommended next pools in dependency order
Save under docs/test-reports or docs/designs
